items.pattern: In recent years, ... has become a topic of heated debate.
items.example: In recent years, whether college students should take part-time jobs has become a topic of heated debate.
items.example_zh: 近年来，大学生是否应该做兼职已成为热议话题。
items.note: has become 前用名词或 whether / wh- 从句作主语。

items.pattern: While some people argue that ..., others hold the view that ...
items.example: While some people argue that online courses are as effective as classroom teaching, others hold the view that face-to-face interaction is irreplaceable.
items.example_zh: 有人认为网课和课堂教学一样有效，另一些人则认为面对面互动不可替代。
items.note: 两派观点都要写成完整从句，注意主谓一致。

items.pattern: Nowadays, the issue of ... has aroused widespread concern.
items.zh: 开头点出现象引发关注
items.example: Nowadays, the issue of food waste on campus has aroused widespread concern.
items.example_zh: 如今，校园食物浪费问题已引起广泛关注。
items.note: of 后接名词短语；concern 前可用 public / great 修饰。

items.pattern: It is widely believed that ..., yet the fact remains that ...
items.zh: 开头先立常见看法再转折
items.example: It is widely believed that technology makes communication easier, yet the fact remains that many young people feel lonelier than ever.
items.example_zh: 人们普遍认为科技让沟通更容易，但事实是许多年轻人比以往更孤独。
items.note: yet 后接与前半句形成反差的完整从句。

items.pattern: There is an old saying that ..., which indicates that ...
items.example: There is an old saying that where there is a will, there is a way, which indicates that perseverance is the key to success.
items.example_zh: 俗话说，有志者事竟成，这说明毅力是成功的关键。
items.note: which 指代整句俗语，后面的 indicates 用第三人称单数。

items.pattern: From my perspective, ... is both beneficial and necessary, provided that ...
items.zh: 开头亮明有条件的立场
items.example: From my perspective, taking a part-time job is both beneficial and necessary, provided that it does not interfere with academic study.
items.example_zh: 在我看来，做兼职既有益也必要，前提是不影响学业。
items.note: provided that = on condition that，引出让步条件。

items.pattern: As is shown in the chart, ... has experienced a dramatic change in recent years.
items.zh: 图表作文开头描述变化
items.example: As is shown in the chart, the number of online shoppers has experienced a dramatic change in recent years.
items.example_zh: 如图所示，网购人数近年来发生了显著变化。
items.note: As is shown 是固定被动结构；change 前可换 sharp / steady。

items.pattern: It is not uncommon to see that ... in our daily life.
items.example: It is not uncommon to see that people scan QR codes to pay even for a bottle of water in our daily life.
items.example_zh: 日常生活中，人们连买一瓶水都扫码支付，这并不少见。
items.note: 双重否定 not uncommon 等于 very common，语气更委婉。

items.pattern: The primary reason for this is that ... . Moreover, ... also plays a crucial role.
items.zh: 主体段给出主因并补充次因
items.example: The primary reason for this is that part-time jobs offer students first-hand experience. Moreover, a suitable job also plays a crucial role in developing time-management skills.
items.example_zh: 主要原因是兼职给学生提供第一手经验。此外，合适的工作对培养时间管理能力也至关重要。
items.note: 两个分句分开写，Moreover 后接完整句。

items.pattern: One major reason for this phenomenon is ... . As a result, ...
items.example: One major reason for this phenomenon is the sharp rise in housing prices. As a result, many young people choose to live with their parents.
items.example_zh: 这一现象的一个主要原因是房价大幅上涨。因此，许多年轻人选择和父母同住。
items.note: As a result 后接结果，不要再用 because 重复因果。

items.pattern: Another contributing factor is ... . Statistics show that ...
items.zh: 主体段补充因素并用数据支撑
items.example: Another contributing factor is the popularity of smartphones. Statistics show that the average user checks the phone more than eighty times a day.
items.example_zh: 另一个促成因素是智能手机的普及。数据显示，普通用户每天查看手机超过八十次。
items.note: Statistics show that 后接完整句；数据要合理，不要编造来源。

items.pattern: A case in point is that ... . This clearly illustrates ...
items.zh: 主体段举例并回扣论点
items.example: A case in point is that many students learn to communicate with customers through part-time work. This clearly illustrates the practical value of such experience.
items.example_zh: 一个典型例子是，许多学生通过兼职学会与顾客沟通。这清楚说明了这类经验的实用价值。
items.note: A case in point is that 后接完整句，不要只接名词。

items.pattern: Take ... for example; it demonstrates that ...
items.example: Take shared bikes for example; it demonstrates that a small technical change can reshape urban traffic.
items.example_zh: 以共享单车为例，它说明一个小技术变化就能重塑城市交通。
items.note: 句子较长时用分号连接，避免逗号拼接。

items.pattern: Nothing is more important than ... when it comes to ...
items.zh: 强调某因素在特定领域的重要性
items.example: Nothing is more important than critical thinking when it comes to evaluating online information.
items.example_zh: 在评估网络信息时，没有什么比批判性思维更重要。
items.note: when it comes to 后接名词或动名词。

items.pattern: It is ... that makes ... possible.
items.example: It is constant practice that makes fluent writing possible.
items.example_zh: 正是持续练习让流畅写作成为可能。
items.note: 强调人时可用 who；强调其他成分用 that。

items.pattern: What matters most is not ... but ...
items.zh: 用主语从句对比两个重点
items.example: What matters most is not how much time we spend, but how we use it.
items.example_zh: 最重要的不是我们花多少时间，而是我们如何使用时间。
items.note: not ... but ... 前后结构要平行。

items.pattern: Compared with ..., ... has its own advantages.
items.example: Compared with traditional shopping, online shopping has its own advantages such as lower prices and greater convenience.
items.example_zh: 与传统购物相比，网购有价格更低、更方便等自身优势。
items.note: Compared with 后接名词；主句主语要与比较对象对应。

items.pattern: Admittedly, ... . Nevertheless, ...
items.zh: 让步后转折，增强辩证性
items.example: Admittedly, part-time jobs may take up some study time. Nevertheless, they teach students lessons that no textbook can offer.
items.example_zh: 诚然，兼职可能占用一些学习时间。然而，它能教给学生课本无法提供的东西。
items.note: Admittedly 放句首；Nevertheless 后用完整句。

items.pattern: Although it is widely believed that ..., the fact remains that ...
items.zh: 承认普遍看法后指出事实
items.example: Although it is widely believed that money brings happiness, the fact remains that close relationships matter far more.
items.example_zh: 虽然人们普遍认为金钱带来幸福，但事实是亲密关系重要得多。
items.note: Although 引导的从句里不能再用 but。

items.pattern: Despite the common misconception that ..., ...
items.example: Despite the common misconception that only geniuses can write well, ordinary students can improve through imitation and practice.
items.example_zh: 尽管人们常误以为只有天才才写得好，普通学生也能通过模仿和练习提高。
items.note: Despite 是介词，后接名词短语；that 从句是 misconception 的同位语。

items.pattern: Everything has two sides, and ... is no exception.
items.example: Everything has two sides, and artificial intelligence is no exception.
items.example_zh: 凡事都有两面，人工智能也不例外。
items.note: 紧接着用 On the one hand / On the other hand 展开。

items.pattern: On the one hand, ...; on the other hand, ...
items.zh: 并列展开利弊或两方面
items.example: On the one hand, mobile payment saves time; on the other hand, it may weaken our awareness of spending.
items.example_zh: 一方面，移动支付节省时间；另一方面，它可能削弱我们的消费意识。
items.note: 两个分句用分号连接，前后词性尽量对称。

items.pattern: However, we have to look at the other side of the coin, that is, ...
items.example: However, we have to look at the other side of the coin, that is, the privacy risks behind big data.
items.example_zh: 然而，我们必须看到硬币的另一面，也就是大数据背后的隐私风险。
items.note: that is 后接名词短语或完整句，用于解释前者。

items.pattern: ... is not so much ... as ...
items.example: Success is not so much a matter of talent as a matter of perseverance.
items.example_zh: 成功与其说是天赋问题，不如说是毅力问题。
items.note: not so much A as B 表示“与其说 A 不如说 B”，A、B 结构要对称。

items.pattern: To address this issue, ... should take effective measures.
items.example: To address this issue, schools and families should take effective measures.
items.example_zh: 为解决这一问题，学校和家庭都应采取有效措施。
items.note: measures 用复数；by 引出被动句的实施主体。

items.pattern: It is advisable that we should ..., and only in this way can we ...
items.zh: 提出建议并倒装强调结果
items.example: It is advisable that we should set a daily time limit for phone use, and only in this way can we regain control of our attention.
items.example_zh: 我们最好给每天的手机使用设定时限，只有这样我们才能重新掌控注意力。
items.note: advisable 后的 that 从句用 should + 动词原形；only in this way 后倒装。

items.pattern: Universities could ... so as to ...
items.zh: 提出学校层面的具体措施
items.example: Universities could offer career guidance so as to help students choose suitable part-time jobs.
items.example_zh: 大学可以提供职业指导，以帮助学生选择合适的兼职。
items.note: so as to 后接动词原形，表示目的。

items.pattern: The government is expected to ... in order that ...
items.example: The government is expected to increase funding for rural schools in order that every child can receive a fair education.
items.example_zh: 政府应增加对农村学校的投入，以便每个孩子都能接受公平教育。
items.note: in order that 后接完整从句，常用 can / could / may。

items.pattern: It is high time that we ...
items.example: It is high time that we took concrete action to reduce food waste.
items.example_zh: 我们早就该采取具体行动减少食物浪费了。
items.note: It is high time that 后接过去式（虚拟语气），不是原形。

items.pattern: More attention should be paid to ...
items.example: More attention should be paid to the mental health of college students.
items.example_zh: 应更加关注大学生的心理健康。
items.note: pay attention to 的被动形式；to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

items.pattern: Instead of ..., we should ...
items.example: Instead of blaming technology, we should learn to use it wisely.
items.example_zh: 与其责怪科技，我们不如学会明智地使用它。
items.note: Instead of 后接名词或动名词，与主句动作形成对照。

items.pattern: Both individuals and society should make joint efforts to ...
items.example: Both individuals and society should make joint efforts to build a low-carbon lifestyle.
items.example_zh: 个人和社会应共同努力，建设低碳生活方式。
items.note: joint efforts 是固定搭配；to 后接动词原形。

items.pattern: To conclude, ... . It is essential that we ...
items.example: To conclude, part-time work is a double-edged sword. It is essential that we weigh its benefits against its costs.
items.example_zh: 总之，兼职是一把双刃剑。我们必须权衡其利弊。
items.note: It is essential that 后接 should + 原形，should 可省略。

items.pattern: From what has been discussed above, we may safely draw the conclusion that ...
items.example: From what has been discussed above, we may safely draw the conclusion that technology is a tool rather than a master.
items.example_zh: 综上所述，我们可以有把握地得出结论：科技是工具而非主人。
items.note: that 后接完整从句；safely 表示“有把握地”。

items.pattern: Taking all these factors into account, we may reach the conclusion that ...
items.example: Taking all these factors into account, we may reach the conclusion that moderate phone use does more good than harm.
items.example_zh: 综合考虑这些因素，我们可以得出结论：适度使用手机利大于弊。
items.note: Taking ... into account 是分词状语，逻辑主语须与主句一致。

items.pattern: All things considered, ...
items.example: All things considered, studying abroad is worth the investment for students who are ready for independence.
items.example_zh: 综合考虑，对准备好独立的学生来说，出国留学值得投入。
items.note: 独立分词结构，后面直接接主句。

items.pattern: Looking ahead, ... will continue to ... . It is our responsibility to ...
items.example: Looking ahead, artificial intelligence will continue to reshape the job market. It is our responsibility to prepare for these changes.
items.example_zh: 展望未来，人工智能将继续重塑就业市场。为这些变化做好准备是我们的责任。
items.note: Looking ahead 是分词状语；responsibility 后常用 to do。

items.pattern: With these efforts, it is reasonable to believe that ...
items.example: With these efforts, it is reasonable to believe that campus food waste will drop steadily.
items.example_zh: 有了这些努力，我们有理由相信校园食物浪费会稳步下降。
items.note: it 是形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。

items.pattern: In short, ... is neither ... nor ...; it is ...
items.zh: 结尾给出更准确的定性
items.example: In short, a part-time job is neither a shortcut to success nor a waste of time; it is a tool whose value depends on how we use it.
items.example_zh: 简言之，兼职既不是成功的捷径，也不是浪费时间；它是一种工具，价值取决于我们如何使用。
items.note: neither ... nor ... 连接的两个成分要平行。

items.pattern: Only when ... can we ...
items.example: Only when we understand the causes of waste can we change our habits effectively.
items.example_zh: 只有当我们理解浪费的成因，才能有效改变习惯。
items.note: Only + 状语从句置于句首，主句部分倒装。

items.pattern: It is ... that ...
items.example: It is lifelong learning that enables people to stay competitive in a changing job market.
items.example_zh: 正是终身学习让人们在变化的就业市场中保持竞争力。
items.note: 去掉 It is ... that 后句子仍完整，才是强调句。

items.pattern: Only by ... can we ...
items.example: Only by working together can we solve the environmental problems facing us.
items.example_zh: 只有共同努力，我们才能解决面临的环境问题。
items.note: Only by + 动名词置于句首，主句倒装。

items.pattern: Not only does ..., but it also ...
items.zh: 倒装递进，强调双重作用
items.example: Not only does reading broaden our horizons, but it also improves our language sense.
items.example_zh: 阅读不仅拓宽我们的视野，还提升我们的语感。
items.note: Not only 置于句首时，前一分句用助动词倒装。

items.pattern: Never before has ...
items.zh: 倒装强调前所未有的程度
items.example: Never before has online shopping exerted such a profound impact on people's consumption habits.
items.example_zh: 网购从未像现在这样深刻影响人们的消费习惯。
items.note: Never before 置句首，助动词 has 提前。

items.pattern: So ... is ... that ...
items.example: So crucial is effective communication that it often determines the success of teamwork.
items.example_zh: 有效沟通如此关键，以至于常常决定团队合作的成败。
items.note: So + 形容词置于句首，主句倒装，that 后接结果从句。

items.pattern: Faced with ..., we should ...
items.zh: 分词状语开头，简洁交代情境
items.example: Faced with a complicated topic, we should first clarify our position before writing.
items.example_zh: 面对复杂话题时，我们应在动笔前先明确立场。
items.note: Faced with 的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。

items.pattern: Having ..., ...
items.example: Having tasted various traditional dishes, students gain a deeper insight into local culture.
items.example_zh: 品尝过各种传统美食后，学生对当地文化有了更深理解。
items.note: Having done 表示动作先于主句发生。

items.pattern: Were it not for ..., ...
items.example: Were it not for the support of my teachers, I could not have overcome those difficulties.
items.example_zh: 要不是老师们的支持，我无法克服那些困难。
items.note: Were it not for = If it were not for；主句用 would / could + have done。
